c_para.Release status: DO NOT FABRICATE OR POWER THIS PCB. Legacy VIN_PROT copper runs from the protected 24 V cabinet input to U1.1 (FB). U1.3 and U1.4 also contact legacy nets. Reroute U1 and verify native ERC/DRC before release.
